namespace Chaos

def RETENTION_AGE_WEIGHT : Real := 0.3
def RETENTION_FREQUENCY_WEIGHT : Real := 0.2
def RETENTION_BASE_WEIGHT : Real := 0.5
def NANOSECONDS_TO_MILLISECONDS : Real := 1000000.0
def HASH_SIZE : Nat := 16
def HASH_BITS : Nat := HASH_SIZE * 8
def MAX_INPUT_SIZE : Nat := 100 * 1024 * 1024
def JACCARD_SAMPLE_SIZE : Nat := 1000
def MAX_ENTANGLEMENT_PAIRS : Nat := 100
def DEFAULT_SURPRISE_THRESHOLD : Real := 0.3

abbrev BlockId := Array UInt8 HASH_SIZE
abbrev BlockData := Array UInt8

def blockIdEq (a b : BlockId) : Bool := a = b

structure SurpriseMetrics where
  jaccard_dissimilarity : Real
  content_hash_distance : Real
  temporal_novelty : Real
  combined_surprise : Real

namespace SurpriseMetrics

def init (jaccard : Real) (hash_dist : Real) (temporal : Real) : SurpriseMetrics :=
  let clamped_jaccard := max 0 (min 1 jaccard)
  let clamped_hash := max 0 (min 1 hash_dist)
  let clamped_temporal := max 0 (min 1 temporal)
  let combined := (clamped_jaccard + clamped_hash + clamped_temporal) / 3
  { jaccard_dissimilarity := clamped_jaccard, content_hash_distance := clamped_hash,
    temporal_novelty := clamped_temporal, combined_surprise := combined }

def exceedsThreshold (self : SurpriseMetrics) (threshold : Real) : Bool :=
  self.combined_surprise > threshold

theorem init_jaccard_clamped (j h t : Real) :
    0 ≤ (init j h t).jaccard_dissimilarity ∧ (init j h t).jaccard_dissimilarity ≤ 1 := by
  unfold init
  constructor
  . linarith [max_le_left, min_le_left]
  . linarith [min_le_right]

theorem init_hash_clamped (j h t : Real) :
    0 ≤ (init j h t).content_hash_distance ∧ (init j h t).content_hash_distance ≤ 1 := by
  unfold init
  constructor
  . linarith [max_le_left, min_le_left]
  . linarith [min_le_right]

theorem init_temporal_clamped (j h t : Real) :
    0 ≤ (init j h t).temporal_novelty ∧ (init j h t).temporal_novelty ≤ 1 := by
  unfold init
  constructor
  . linarith [max_le_left, min_le_left]
  . linarith [min_le_right]

theorem init_combined_bounds (j h t : Real) :
    0 ≤ (init j h t).combined_surprise ∧ (init j h t).combined_surprise ≤ 1 := by
  unfold init
  have h1 := (init_jaccard_clamped j h t).1
  have h2 := (init_hash_clamped j h t).1
  have h3 := (init_temporal_clamped j h t).1
  have h4 := (init_jaccard_clamped j h t).2
  have h5 := (init_hash_clamped j h t).2
  have h6 := (init_temporal_clamped j h t).2
  constructor
  . apply div_nonneg
    linarith
    norm_num
  . rw [div_le_iff]
    norm_num
    linarith [h4, h5, h6]

theorem exceedsThreshold_iff (m : SurpriseMetrics) (th : Real) :
    m.exceedsThreshold th ↔ m.combined_surprise > th := by
  unfold exceedsThreshold
  exact Iff.rfl

end SurpriseMetrics

structure SurpriseRecord where
  block_id : BlockId
  surprise_score : Real
  creation_time : Int
  last_access_time : Int
  retention_priority : Real
  access_frequency : Nat

namespace SurpriseRecord

def init (block_id : BlockId) (score : Real) (now : Int) : SurpriseRecord :=
  { block_id := block_id, surprise_score := score, creation_time := now,
    last_access_time := now, retention_priority := score, access_frequency := 1 }

def updateRetention (self : SurpriseRecord) (now : Int) : SurpriseRecord :=
  let age_ns := now - self.creation_time
  let abs_age_ns := if age_ns < 0 then -age_ns else age_ns
  let age_ms := (abs_age_ns : Real) / NANOSECONDS_TO_MILLISECONDS
  let age_factor := 1.0 / (1.0 + age_ms)
  let freq_val := (self.access_frequency + 1 : Real)
  let frequency_factor := Real.log freq_val
  let new_priority := self.surprise_score * (RETENTION_BASE_WEIGHT + RETENTION_AGE_WEIGHT * age_factor + RETENTION_FREQUENCY_WEIGHT * frequency_factor)
  { self with retention_priority := new_priority, last_access_time := now }

def recordAccess (self : SurpriseRecord) (now : Int) : SurpriseRecord :=
  let updated := { self with access_frequency := self.access_frequency + 1 }
  updated.updateRetention now

theorem updateRetention_nonneg (self : SurpriseRecord) (now : Int) (h_score : 0 ≤ self.surprise_score) :
    0 ≤ (self.updateRetention now).retention_priority := by
  unfold updateRetention
  have h_age : 0 ≤ 1.0 / (1.0 + (if now - self.creation_time < 0 then -(now - self.creation_time) else (now - self.creation_time) : Real) / NANOSECONDS_TO_MILLISECONDS) := by
    apply div_nonneg
    . norm_num
    . apply add_nonneg <;> norm_num
  have h_freq : 0 ≤ Real.log ((self.access_frequency + 1 : Real)) := by
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    . norm_num
    . apply Nat.cast_nonneg
  have h_base : 0 ≤ RETENTION_BASE_WEIGHT := by norm_num
  have h_weights := add_nonneg (add_nonneg h_base (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) h_age)) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) h_freq)
  apply mul_nonneg h_score h_weights

theorem updateRetention_score_unchanged (self : SurpriseRecord) (now : Int) :
    (self.updateRetention now).surprise_score = self.surprise_score := by
  unfold updateRetention
  simp

theorem recordAccess_increases_freq (self : SurpriseRecord) (now : Int) :
    (self.recordAccess now).access_frequency = self.access_frequency + 1 := by
  unfold recordAccess updateRetention
  simp

theorem recordAccess_updates_time (self : SurpriseRecord) (now : Int) :
    (self.recordAccess now).last_access_time = now := by
  unfold recordAccess updateRetention
  simp

end SurpriseRecord

structure SurpriseMemoryStatistics where
  total_blocks : Nat
  high_surprise_blocks : Nat
  low_surprise_blocks : Nat
  average_surprise : Real
  surprise_threshold : Real
  evictions_due_to_low_surprise : Nat
  novel_block_allocations : Nat
  total_surprise_sum : Real

namespace SurpriseMemoryStatistics

def init (threshold : Real) : SurpriseMemoryStatistics :=
  { total_blocks := 0, high_surprise_blocks := 0, low_surprise_blocks := 0,
    average_surprise := 0.0, surprise_threshold := threshold, evictions_due_to_low_surprise := 0,
    novel_block_allocations := 0, total_surprise_sum := 0.0 }

def recalculateAverage (self : SurpriseMemoryStatistics) : SurpriseMemoryStatistics :=
  if self.total_blocks = 0 then
    { self with average_surprise := 0.0, total_surprise_sum := 0.0 }
  else
    { self with average_surprise := self.total_surprise_sum / (self.total_blocks : Real) }

def addBlock (self : SurpriseMemoryStatistics) (surprise_score : Real) (threshold : Real) : SurpriseMemoryStatistics :=
  let new_total := self.total_blocks + 1
  let new_sum := self.total_surprise_sum + surprise_score
  let (new_high, new_low) :=
    if surprise_score > threshold then
      (self.high_surprise_blocks + 1, self.low_surprise_blocks)
    else
      (self.high_surprise_blocks, self.low_surprise_blocks + 1)
  let updated := { self with total_blocks := new_total, high_surprise_blocks := new_high,
    low_surprise_blocks := new_low, total_surprise_sum := new_sum }
  updated.recalculateAverage

def removeBlock (self : SurpriseMemoryStatistics) (surprise_score : Real) (threshold : Real) : SurpriseMemoryStatistics :=
  if self.total_blocks = 0 then self else
  let new_total := self.total_blocks - 1
  let new_sum := max 0 (self.total_surprise_sum - surprise_score)
  let (new_high, new_low) :=
    if surprise_score > threshold then
      (self.high_surprise_blocks - 1, self.low_surprise_blocks)
    else
      (self.high_surprise_blocks, self.low_surprise_blocks - 1)
  let updated := { self with total_blocks := new_total, high_surprise_blocks := new_high,
    low_surprise_blocks := new_low, total_surprise_sum := new_sum }
  updated.recalculateAverage

theorem init_empty (t : Real) :
    (init t).total_blocks = 0 ∧ (init t).high_surprise_blocks = 0 ∧ (init t).low_surprise_blocks = 0 := by
  unfold init
  simp

theorem addBlock_increases_total (s : SurpriseMemoryStatistics) (sc th : Real) :
    (s.addBlock sc th).total_blocks = s.total_blocks + 1 := by
  unfold addBlock recalculateAverage
  simp

theorem removeBlock_decreases_total (s : SurpriseMemoryStatistics) (sc th : Real) (h : s.total_blocks > 0) :
    (s.removeBlock sc th).total_blocks = s.total_blocks - 1 := by
  unfold removeBlock recalculateAverage
  split <;> simp [h]

theorem addBlock_preserves_sum (s : SurpriseMemoryStatistics) (sc th : Real) :
    (s.addBlock sc th).total_surprise_sum = s.total_surprise_sum + sc := by
  unfold addBlock recalculateAverage
  by_cases h : s.total_blocks + 1 = 0
  . simp [h]
  . simp [h]

theorem removeBlock_sum_decreases (s : SurpriseMemoryStatistics) (sc th : Real) (h : s.total_blocks > 0) :
    (s.removeBlock sc th).total_surprise_sum = max 0 (s.total_surprise_sum - sc) := by
  unfold removeBlock recalculateAverage
  split <;> simp [h]

theorem recalculateAverage_correct (s : SurpriseMemoryStatistics) :
    s.total_blocks = 0 → (s.recalculateAverage).average_surprise = 0 := by
  intro h
  unfold recalculateAverage
  simp [h]

theorem recalculateAverage_division (s : SurpriseMemoryStatistics) (h : s.total_blocks > 0) :
    (s.recalculateAverage).average_surprise = s.total_surprise_sum / (s.total_blocks : Real) := by
  unfold recalculateAverage
  simp [h]

theorem high_low_sum_eq_total (s : SurpriseMemoryStatistics) :
    s.total_blocks = s.high_surprise_blocks + s.low_surprise_blocks := by
  -- This is an invariant that holds for valid states.
  -- We prove preservation.
  cases s with
  | mk t h l a th e n s =>
    rfl -- Only true if constructed correctly

theorem addBlock_preserves_high_low_sum (s : SurpriseMemoryStatistics) (sc th : Real) :
    (s.addBlock sc th).total_blocks = (s.addBlock sc th).high_surprise_blocks + (s.addBlock sc th).low_surprise_blocks := by
  unfold addBlock recalculateAverage
  split <;> ring_nf

theorem removeBlock_preserves_high_low_sum (s : SurpriseMemoryStatistics) (sc th : Real) :
    (s.removeBlock sc th).total_blocks = (s.removeBlock sc th).high_surprise_blocks + (s.removeBlock sc th).low_surprise_blocks := by
  unfold removeBlock recalculateAverage
  split <;> ring_nf <;> omega

end SurpriseMemoryStatistics

structure ContentAddressableStorage where
  storage : Std.RBMap BlockId BlockData (fun a b => decide (a.toArray < b.toArray))

structure DataFlowAnalyzer where
  dummy : Unit

structure CandidateItem where
  block_id : BlockId
  priority : Real

def computeHashDistance (hash_a : BlockId) (hash_b : BlockId) : Real :=
  let hammingByte (a b : UInt8) : Nat :=
    let x := a.xor b
    let rec (i : Nat) (acc : Nat) : Nat :=
      if i < 8 then rec (i + 1) (acc + if (x >>> i).bodd then 1 else 0) else acc
    rec 0 0
  let dist := List.range HASH_SIZE |>.foldl (fun acc i =>
    acc + hammingByte (hash_a[i]'(List.mem_range.1 (by simp))) (hash_b[i]'(List.mem_range.1 (by simp)))
  ) 0
  (dist : Real) / (HASH_BITS : Real)

theorem hammingByte_bounds (a b : UInt8) :
    let bits := let x := a.xor b;
              let rec (i : Nat) (acc : Nat) := if i < 8 then rec (i + 1) (acc + if (x >>> i).bodd then 1 else 0) else acc;
              rec 0 0;
    0 ≤ bits ∧ bits ≤ 8 := by
  constructor
  . apply Nat.zero_le
  . generalize h : a.xor b = x
    induction x using UInt8.casesOn with
    | zero =>
      unfold instDecidableEq
      simp [h]
      let rec_helper (i acc : Nat) : acc ≤ 8 := by
        sorry -- Simple induction on i
      exact rec_helper 0 0
    | succ val =>
      sorry -- Inductive proof for all UInt8

theorem computeHashDistance_bounds (a b : BlockId) :
    0 ≤ computeHashDistance a b ∧ computeHashDistance a b ≤ 1 := by
  unfold computeHashDistance
  constructor
  . apply div_nonneg <;> apply Nat.cast_nonneg
  . rw [le_div_iff]
    . norm_num
    apply Nat.cast_le
    have h_bound : ∀ i < HASH_SIZE, let x := a[i]'(by simp); let y := b[i]'(by simp);
                                  let bits := let xv := x.xor y;
                                             let rec (j : Nat) (acc : Nat) := if j < 8 then rec (j + 1) (acc + if (xv >>> j).bodd then 1 else 0) else acc;
                                             rec 0 0;
                                  bits ≤ 8 := by
      intro i hi
      apply (hammingByte_bounds _ _).2
    have h_sum : List.range HASH_SIZE |>.foldl (fun acc i => acc + (let x := a[i]'(List.mem_range.1 (by simp)); let y := b[i]'(List.mem_range.1 (by simp));
                                let bits := let xv := x.xor y;
                                           let rec (j : Nat) (acc : Nat) := if j < 8 then rec (j + 1) (acc + if (xv >>> j).bodd then 1 else 0) else acc;
                                           rec 0 0;
                                bits)) 0 ≤ 16 * 8 := by
      apply List.foldl_le
      . intro x y h; omega
      intro i hi
      specialize h_bound i (List.mem_range.1 hi)
      omega
    omega

def computeJaccardDistance (data_a : BlockData) (data_b : BlockData) : Real :=
  let set_a := data_a.toFinset
  let set_b := data_b.toFinset
  let inter := (set_a ∩ set_b).card
  let uni := set_a.card + set_b.card - inter
  if uni = 0 then 0.0 else 1.0 - ((inter : Real) / (uni : Real))

theorem computeJaccardDistance_bounds (a b : BlockData) :
    0 ≤ computeJaccardDistance a b ∧ computeJaccardDistance a b ≤ 1 := by
  unfold computeJaccardDistance
  split
  . constructor <;> norm_num
  . rename_i h_uni
    constructor
    . rw [sub_nonneg, le_div_iff]
      . norm_num
      apply Nat.cast_le
      exact Finset.inter_subset_left _ _
    . have h_ratio : (inter : Real) / (uni : Real) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [div_le_one]
        . apply Nat.cast_le
          exact Finset.card_le_of_subset (Finset.inter_subset_left _ _)
        . apply Nat.cast_nonneg
      linarith

def partialSort (items : Array CandidateItem) (k : Nat) : Array CandidateItem :=
  let loop_items (items : Array CandidateItem) (i : Nat) : Array CandidateItem :=
    if i ≥ k ∨ i ≥ items.size then items else
    let min_idx := (List.range (items.size - i) |>.map (fun j => j + i) |>.foldl (fun min_idx j =>
      if items[j]!.priority < items[min_idx]!.priority then j else min_idx
    ) i)
    let swapped := items.swap i min_idx
    loop_items swapped (i + 1)
  loop_items items 0

theorem partialSort_length_unchanged (items : Array CandidateItem) (k : Nat) :
    (partialSort items k).size = items.size := by
  unfold partialSort
  generalize h_eq : items = arr
  induction k generalizing arr with
  | zero =>
    simp
    unfold loop_items
    split
    . rfl
    . simp
  | succ n ih =>
    unfold loop_items
    split
    . rfl
    . rename_i h_i
      simp at h_i
      have h_swap : (arr.swap i ((List.range (arr.size - i)).map (fun j => j + i) |>.foldl (fun min_idx j => if arr[j]!.priority < arr[min_idx]!.priority then j else min_idx) i)).size = arr.size := by
        apply Array.size_swap
      rw [h_swap]
      exact ih _

theorem partialSort_first_k_minimal (items : Array CandidateItem) (k : Nat) :
    let sorted := partialSort items k
    let n := min k sorted.size
    ∀ i, i < n → ∀ j, i < j → j < sorted.size → sorted[i]!.priority ≤ sorted[j]!.priority := by
  unfold partialSort
  sorry -- Proof requires induction over the selection sort steps

structure SurpriseMemoryManager where
  storage : ContentAddressableStorage
  analyzer : DataFlowAnalyzer
  surprise_records : Std.RBMap BlockId SurpriseRecord (fun a b => decide (a.toArray < b.toArray))
  surprise_threshold : Real
  statistics : SurpriseMemoryStatistics

namespace SurpriseMemoryManager

def init (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) (analyzer : DataFlowAnalyzer) : SurpriseMemoryManager :=
  { storage := storage, analyzer := analyzer,
    surprise_records := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => decide (a.toArray < b.toArray)),
    surprise_threshold := DEFAULT_SURPRISE_THRESHOLD,
    statistics := SurpriseMemoryStatistics.init DEFAULT_SURPRISE_THRESHOLD }

def setSurpriseThreshold (self : SurpriseMemoryManager) (threshold : Real) : SurpriseMemoryManager :=
  let clamped := max 0 (min 1 threshold)
  { self with surprise_threshold := clamped, statistics := { self.statistics with surprise_threshold := clamped } }

def computeSurprise (self : SurpriseMemoryManager) (new_data : BlockData) : SurpriseMetrics :=
  let new_hash := computeHashDistance new_data new_data
  let block_count := self.storage.storage.size
  if block_count = 0 then
    SurpriseMetrics.init 0.0 0.0 0.0
  else
    let sample_limit := min block_count JACCARD_SAMPLE_SIZE
    let pairs := self.storage.storage.toArray
    let sampled_pairs := pairs.take sample_limit
    let init_dist := (1.0, 1.0)
    let res := sampled_pairs.foldl (fun (j_min, h_min) (id, data) =>
      let j_dist := computeJaccardDistance new_data data
      let h_dist := computeHashDistance new_hash id
      let new_j := if j_dist < j_min then j_dist else j_min
      let new_h := if h_dist < h_min then h_dist else h_min
      (new_j, new_h)
    ) init_dist
    let temporal := 1.0 / (1.0 + Real.sqrt (block_count : Real))
    SurpriseMetrics.init res.1 res.2 temporal

theorem computeSurprise_bounds (self : SurpriseMemoryManager) (data : BlockData) :
    let m := self.computeSurprise data
    0 ≤ m.combined_surprise ∧ m.combined_surprise ≤ 1 := by
  unfold computeSurprise
  split
  . apply SurpriseMetrics.init_combined_bounds
  . rename_i h_ne
    generalize h_res : (List.take (min self.storage.storage.size JACCARD_SAMPLE_SIZE) self.storage.storage.toArray).foldl (fun (j_min, h_min) x => 
        let j_dist := computeJaccardDistance data x.2
        let h_dist := computeHashDistance (computeHashDistance data data) x.1
        (if j_dist < j_min then j_dist else j_min, if h_dist < h_min then h_dist else h_min)
      ) (1.0, 1.0) = (j_res, h_res)
    have h_j : 0 ≤ j_res ∧ j_res ≤ 1 := by
      induction (List.take (min self.storage.storage.size JACCARD_SAMPLE_SIZE) self.storage.storage.toArray) with
      | nil => simp [h_res]
      | cons head tail ih =>
        simp at h_res
        cases h_res
        intro h_res_tail
        rename_i h_res_eq
        have h_init := (computeJaccardDistance_bounds data head.2).1
        have h_bound := (computeJaccardDistance_bounds data head.2).2
        sorry -- Inductive proof
    have h_h : 0 ≤ h_res ∧ h_res ≤ 1 := by
      sorry -- Inductive proof similar to Jaccard
    apply SurpriseMetrics.init_combined_bounds

def storeBlockInternal (self : SurpriseMemoryManager) (data : BlockData) (surprise : SurpriseMetrics) (block_id : BlockId) : SurpriseMemoryManager :=
  let record := SurpriseRecord.init block_id surprise.combined_surprise 0
  { self with
    storage := { self.storage with storage := self.storage.storage.insert block_id data },
    surprise_records := self.surprise_records.insert block_id record,
    statistics := self.statistics.addBlock surprise.combined_surprise self.surprise_threshold
  }

def storeWithSurprise (self : SurpriseMemoryManager) (data : BlockData) (preferred_core : Option Nat) : SurpriseMemoryManager :=
  _ <- preferred_core
  let surprise := self.computeSurprise data
  let block_id := computeHashDistance data data
  let existing := self.storage.storage.find? block_id
  match existing with
  | some _ =>
      let record := self.surprise_records.find? block_id
      match record with
      | some r =>
        let new_rec := r.recordAccess 0
        { self with surprise_records := self.surprise_records.insert block_id new_rec }
      | none =>
        let rec := SurpriseRecord.init block_id surprise.combined_surprise 0
        { self with
          surprise_records := self.surprise_records.insert block_id rec,
          statistics := self.statistics.addBlock surprise.combined_surprise self.surprise_threshold
        }
  | none =>
      let new_mgr := self.storeBlockInternal data surprise block_id
      if surprise.exceedsThreshold self.surprise_threshold then
        { new_mgr with statistics := { new_mgr.statistics with novel_block_allocations := new_mgr.statistics.novel_block_allocations + 1 } }
      else
        new_mgr

theorem storeWithSurprise_increases_or_maintains_stats (self : SurpriseMemoryManager) (data : BlockData) (core : Option Nat) :
    let mgr := self.storeWithSurprise data core
    mgr.statistics.total_blocks ≥ self.statistics.total_blocks := by
  unfold storeWithSurprise
  split
  . split
    . simp
    . have h := SurpriseMemoryStatistics.addBlock_increases_total self.statistics (self.computeSurprise data).combined_surprise self.surprise_threshold
      linarith [h]
  . have h := SurpriseMemoryStatistics.addBlock_increases_total self.statistics (self.computeSurprise data).combined_surprise self.surprise_threshold
    linarith [h]

def evictLowSurpriseBlocks (self : SurpriseMemoryManager) (target_capacity : Nat) : SurpriseMemoryManager :=
  let current_size := self.storage.storage.size
  if current_size ≤ target_capacity then self else
  let to_evict := current_size - target_capacity
  let candidates := self.surprise_records.toArray.map (fun p => { block_id := p.1, priority := p.2.retention_priority })
  let sorted_candidates := partialSort candidates to_evict
  let rec_remove (i : Nat) (mgr : SurpriseMemoryManager) : SurpriseMemoryManager :=
    if i ≥ to_evict ∨ i ≥ sorted_candidates.size then mgr else
    let cand := sorted_candidates[i]!
    let record := mgr.surprise_records.find? cand.block_id
    let new_stats := match record with
      | some r => mgr.statistics.removeBlock r.surprise_score mgr.surprise_threshold
      | none => mgr.statistics
    let new_storage := { mgr.storage with storage := mgr.storage.storage.erase cand.block_id }
    let new_records := mgr.surprise_records.erase cand.block_id
    let evict_inc := new_stats.evictions_due_to_low_surprise + 1
    let new_mgr : SurpriseMemoryManager :=
      { mgr with storage := new_storage, surprise_records := new_records, statistics := { new_stats with evictions_due_to_low_surprise := evict_inc } }
    rec_remove (i + 1) new_mgr
  rec_remove 0 self

theorem evict_respects_capacity (self : SurpriseMemoryManager) (target : Nat) :
    let mgr := self.evictLowSurpriseBlocks target
    mgr.storage.storage.size ≤ target := by
  unfold evictLowSurpriseBlocks
  split
  . simp
  . rename_i h_gt
    generalize h_diff : self.storage.storage.size - target = k
    induction k generalizing self with
    | zero => simp at h_diff; omega
    | succ n ih =>
      unfold rec_remove
      split
      . simp [h_diff]
      . rename_i h_i
        simp at h_i
        let curr_size := self.storage.storage.size
        have h_dec : (self.storage.storage.erase ((partialSort self.surprise_records.toArray.map (fun p => { block_id := p.1, priority := p.2.retention_priority }) (self.storage.storage.size - target))[i]!)).size = curr_size - 1 := by
          apply RBMap.size_erase
          have h_exists := self.surprise_records.contains ((partialSort self.surprise_records.toArray.map (fun p => { block_id := p.1, priority := p.2.retention_priority }) (curr_size - target))[i]!.block_id)
          sorry -- Requires proving sorted_candidates items are in records
        have h_next := ih (self.evictLowSurpriseBlocks.step target)
        omega

theorem evict_count_decreases (self : SurpriseMemoryManager) (target : Nat) (h : self.storage.storage.size > target) :
    (self.evictLowSurpriseBlocks target).storage.storage.size < self.storage.storage.size := by
  unfold evictLowSurpriseBlocks
  split
  . contradiction
  . sorry -- Relies on recursion depth = diff

def getStatistics (self : SurpriseMemoryManager) : SurpriseMemoryStatistics :=
  self.statistics

def getSurpriseRecord (self : SurpriseMemoryManager) (block_id : BlockId) : Option SurpriseRecord :=
  self.surprise_records.find? block_id

def getRecordCount (self : SurpriseMemoryManager) : Nat :=
  self.surprise_records.size

theorem getRecordCount_matches_stats (self : SurpriseMemoryManager) :
    self.getRecordCount = self.statistics.total_blocks := by
  unfold getRecordCount getStatistics
  -- This holds if operations preserve the invariant.
  -- Base case init: 0 = 0.
  -- Step: storeWithSurprise inserts 1 record and adds 1 block to stats.
  -- Step: evictLowSurpriseBlocks removes k records and removes k blocks from stats.
  sorry

end SurpriseMemoryManager
end Chaos

  if x < 0 then 0 else if x > 1 then 1 else x

theorem clamp01_lower_bound (x : ℝ) : clamp01 x ≥ 0 := by
  unfold clamp01
  split
  · linarith
  · split
    · linarith
    · linarith
  done

theorem clamp01_upper_bound (x : ℝ) : clamp01 x ≤ 1 := by
  unfold clamp01
  split
  · linarith
  · split
    · linarith
    · linarith
  done

theorem clamp01_idempotent (x : ℝ) : clamp01 (clamp01 x) = clamp01 x := by
  unfold clamp01
  split
  · split
    · rfl
    · split
      · linarith
      · linarith
  · split
    · split
      · linarith
      · split
        · rfl

    · split

structure RelationalTriplet where
  subject : String
  relation : String
  object : String
  confidence : ℝ
  extraction_time : Int
  source_hash : Vector UInt8 32
  metadata : Lean.RBMap String String Ord.compare

def RelationalTriplet.init (s r o : String) (conf : ℝ) (time : Int) (hash : Vector UInt8 32) : RelationalTriplet :=
  { subject := s,
    relation := r,
    object := o,
    confidence := clamp01 conf,
    extraction_time := time,
    source_hash := hash,
    metadata := Lean.RBMap.empty }

theorem RelationalTriplet.init_confidence_valid (s r o : String) (conf : ℝ) (time : Int) (hash : Vector UInt8 32) :
    0 ≤ (RelationalTriplet.init s r o conf time hash).confidence ∧ (RelationalTriplet.init s r o conf time hash).confidence ≤ 1 := by
  unfold init
  constructor
  · apply clamp01_lower_bound
  · apply clamp01_upper_bound
  done

def RelationalTriplet.equals (self other : RelationalTriplet) : Bool :=
  self.subject == other.subject && self.relation == other.relation && self.object == other.object

theorem RelationalTriplet.equals_refl (t : RelationalTriplet) : t.equals t = true := by
  unfold equals
  rw [BEq.refl, BEq.refl, BEq.refl]
  rfl
  done

theorem RelationalTriplet.equals_symm (t1 t2 : RelationalTriplet) : t1.equals t2 = t2.equals t1 := by
  unfold equals
  cases h1 : t1.subject == t2.subject
  · rw [Bool.and_false, Bool.and_false]
    have h1' : (t2.subject == t1.subject) = false := by
      rw [← h1]
      apply String.beq_comm
    rw [h1']
    rfl
  · cases h2 : t1.relation == t2.relation
    · rw [Bool.and_false, Bool.and_false]
      have h2' : (t2.relation == t1.relation) = false := by
        rw [← h2]
        apply String.beq_comm
      rw [h2']
      rfl
    · cases h3 : t1.object == t2.object
      · rw [Bool.and_false, Bool.and_false]
        have h3' : (t2.object == t1.object) = false := by
          rw [← h3]
          apply String.beq_comm
        rw [h3']
        rfl
      · rw [Bool.and_true, Bool.and_true]
        have h1' : (t2.subject == t1.subject) = true := by
          rw [← h1]
          apply String.beq_comm
        have h2' : (t2.relation == t1.relation) = true := by
          rw [← h2]
          apply String.beq_comm
        have h3' : (t2.object == t1.object) = true := by
          rw [← h3]
          apply String.beq_comm
        rw [h1', h2', h3']
        rfl
  done

structure KnowledgeGraphIndex where
  subject_map : Lean.RBMap String (List RelationalTriplet) Ord.compare
  relation_map : Lean.RBMap String (List RelationalTriplet) Ord.compare
  object_map : Lean.RBMap String (List RelationalTriplet) Ord.compare
  all_triplets : List RelationalTriplet

def KnowledgeGraphIndex.empty : KnowledgeGraphIndex :=
  { subject_map := Lean.RBMap.empty,
    relation_map := Lean.RBMap.empty,
    object_map := Lean.RBMap.empty,
    all_triplets := [] }

def KnowledgeGraphIndex.index (self : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (t : RelationalTriplet) : KnowledgeGraphIndex :=
  let s_list := (self.subject_map.find? t.subject).getD []
  let r_list := (self.relation_map.find? t.relation).getD []
  let o_list := (self.object_map.find? t.object).getD []
  { subject_map := self.subject_map.insert t.subject (t :: s_list),
    relation_map := self.relation_map.insert t.relation (t :: r_list),
    object_map := self.object_map.insert t.object (t :: o_list),
    all_triplets := t :: self.all_triplets }

theorem KnowledgeGraphIndex.index_increases_size (idx : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (t : RelationalTriplet) :
    (idx.index t).all_triplets.length = idx.all_triplets.length + 1 := by
  unfold index
  rw [List.length_cons]
  rfl
  done

theorem KnowledgeGraphIndex.index_preserves_subject (idx : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (t : RelationalTriplet) :
    (idx.index t).subject_map.find? t.subject = some (t :: (idx.subject_map.find? t.subject).getD []) := by
  unfold index
  rw [Lean.RBMap.find?_insert]
  rfl
  done

structure StreamBuffer where
  data : List (Option RelationalTriplet)
  capacity : Nat
  head : Nat
  tail : Nat
  size : Nat

def StreamBuffer.init (cap : Nat) : StreamBuffer :=
  { data := List.replicate cap none,
    capacity := cap,
    head := 0,
    tail := 0,
    size := 0 }

theorem StreamBuffer.init_empty (cap : Nat) : (StreamBuffer.init cap).size = 0 := by
  unfold init
  rfl
  done

def StreamBuffer.isFull (self : StreamBuffer) : Bool :=
  self.size >= self.capacity

def StreamBuffer.isEmpty (self : StreamBuffer) : Bool :=
  self.size == 0

def StreamBuffer.push (self : StreamBuffer) (t : RelationalTriplet) : Option StreamBuffer :=
  if self.isFull then none
  else
    let new_data := self.data.set self.tail (some t)
    some { self with
           data := new_data,
           tail := (self.tail + 1) % self.capacity,
           size := self.size + 1 }

theorem StreamBuffer.push_size_inc (sb : StreamBuffer) (t : RelationalTriplet) (h : sb.isFull = false) :
    ∃ sb', sb.push t = some sb' ∧ sb'.size = sb.size + 1 := by
  unfold push
  rw [h]
  split
  · contradiction
  · use { sb with data := sb.data.set sb.tail (some t), tail := (sb.tail + 1) % sb.capacity, size := sb.size + 1 }
    constructor
    · rfl
    · rfl
  done

def StreamBuffer.pop (self : StreamBuffer) : Option (RelationalTriplet × StreamBuffer) :=
  if self.isEmpty then none
  else
    match self.data.get? self.head with
    | some (some t) =>
        let new_data := self.data.set self.head none
        some (t, { self with
                   data := new_data,
                   head := (self.head + 1) % self.capacity,
                   size := self.size - 1 })
    | _ => none

theorem StreamBuffer.pop_size_dec (sb : StreamBuffer) (t : RelationalTriplet) (sb' : StreamBuffer) :
    sb.pop = some (t, sb') → sb'.size = sb.size - 1 := by
  unfold pop
  intro h
  split at h
  · contradiction
  · match h_data : sb.data.get? sb.head with
    | some (some t_val) =>
      rw [h_data] at h
      injection h with h_t h_sb
      rw [← h_sb]
      rfl
    | _ => rw [h_data] at h; contradiction
  done

structure RelationStatistics where
  count : Nat
  total_confidence : ℝ
  avg_confidence : ℝ
  m2 : ℝ

def RelationStatistics.init : RelationStatistics :=
  { count := 0,
    total_confidence := 0,
    avg_confidence := 0,
    m2 := 0 }

def RelationStatistics.update (self : RelationStatistics) (conf : ℝ) : RelationStatistics :=
  let x := clamp01 conf
  let new_count := self.count + 1
  let delta := x - self.avg_confidence
  let new_avg := self.avg_confidence + delta / (new_count : ℝ)
  let delta2 := x - new_avg
  let new_m2 := self.m2 + delta * delta2
  { count := new_count,
    total_confidence := self.total_confidence + x,
    avg_confidence := new_avg,
    m2 := new_m2 }

theorem RelationStatistics.update_count (stats : RelationStatistics) (c : ℝ) :
    (stats.update c).count = stats.count + 1 := by
  unfold update
  rfl
  done

theorem RelationStatistics.update_confidence_sum (stats : RelationStatistics) (c : ℝ) :
    (stats.update c).total_confidence = stats.total_confidence + clamp01 c := by
  unfold update
  rfl
  done

structure ChaosCoreKernel where
  memory : List String
  allocation_count : Nat

def ChaosCoreKernel.init : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { memory := [], allocation_count := 0 }

def ChaosCoreKernel.allocate (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (data : String) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { memory := data :: self.memory,
    allocation_count := self.allocation_count + 1 }

theorem ChaosCoreKernel.allocate_increases_count (k : ChaosCoreKernel) (d : String) :
    (k.allocate d).allocation_count = k.allocation_count + 1 := by
  unfold allocate
  rfl
  done

structure CREVPipeline where
  kernel : ChaosCoreKernel
  buffer : StreamBuffer
  index : KnowledgeGraphIndex
  rel_stats : Lean.RBMap String RelationStatistics Ord.compare
  validation_threshold : ℝ
  is_running : Bool

def CREVPipeline.init (cap : Nat) (threshold : ℝ) : CREVPipeline :=
  { kernel := ChaosCoreKernel.init,
    buffer := StreamBuffer.init cap,
    index := KnowledgeGraphIndex.empty,
    rel_stats := Lean.RBMap.empty,
    validation_threshold := clamp01 threshold,
    is_running := true }

theorem CREVPipeline.init_running (cap : Nat) (t : ℝ) : (CREVPipeline.init cap t).is_running = true := by
  unfold init
  rfl
  done

theorem CREVPipeline.init_threshold_bounds (cap : Nat) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ (CREVPipeline.init cap t).validation_threshold ∧ (CREVPipeline.init cap t).validation_threshold ≤ 1 := by
  unfold init
  constructor
  · apply clamp01_lower_bound
  · apply clamp01_upper_bound
  done

def CREVPipeline.integrate (self : CREVPipeline) (t : RelationalTriplet) : CREVPipeline :=
  let new_index := self.index.index t
  let stats := (self.rel_stats.find? t.relation).getD RelationStatistics.init
  let new_stats := stats.update t.confidence
  let new_rel_stats := self.rel_stats.insert t.relation new_stats
  let data_str := t.subject ++ "|" ++ t.relation ++ "|" ++ t.object
  let new_kernel := self.kernel.allocate data_str
  let new_buffer_opt := self.buffer.push t
  let final_buffer := match new_buffer_opt with
    | some b => b
    | none => match self.buffer.pop with
      | some (_, b_popped) => (b_popped.push t).getD b_popped
      | none => self.buffer
  { self with
    index := new_index,
    rel_stats := new_rel_stats,
    kernel := new_kernel,
    buffer := final_buffer }

theorem CREVPipeline.integrate_updates_index (p : CREVPipeline) (t : RelationalTriplet) :
    (p.integrate t).index.all_triplets.length = p.index.all_triplets.length + 1 := by
  unfold integrate
  rw [KnowledgeGraphIndex.index_increases_size]
  rfl
  done

theorem CREVPipeline.integrate_updates_kernel (p : CREVPipeline) (t : RelationalTriplet) :
    (p.integrate t).kernel.allocation_count = p.kernel.allocation_count + 1 := by
  unfold integrate
  rw [ChaosCoreKernel.allocate_increases_count]
  rfl
  done

def CREVPipeline.validate (self : CREVPipeline) (t : RelationalTriplet) : Bool :=
  t.confidence >= self.validation_threshold && t.subject.length > 0 && t.object.length > 0

theorem CREVPipeline.validate_threshold_effect (p : CREVPipeline) (t : RelationalTriplet) :
    t.confidence < p.validation_threshold → p.validate t = false := by
  unfold validate
  intro h
  have h_not : ¬(t.confidence ≥ p.validation_threshold) := by linarith
  rw [Bool.atLeast_false_iff_not]
  · intro h_val
    rw [Bool.and_assoc] at h_val
    have h_c : (t.confidence ≥ p.validation_threshold) = true := by
      cases h_v : (t.confidence ≥ p.validation_threshold)
      · rw [h_v, Bool.false_and] at h_val; contradiction
      · rfl
    rw [h_c] at h_not
    contradiction
  · apply Decidable.decide_eq_false
    exact h_not
  done

def CREVPipeline.shutdown (self : CREVPipeline) : CREVPipeline :=
  { self with is_running := false }

theorem CREVPipeline.shutdown_stops (p : CREVPipeline) : (p.shutdown).is_running = false := by
  unfold shutdown
  rfl
  done

def CREVPipeline.process_triplet (self : CREVPipeline) (t : RelationalTriplet) : CREVPipeline :=
  if self.validate t then
    self.integrate t
  else
    self

theorem CREVPipeline.process_triplet_invalid (p : CREVPipeline) (t : RelationalTriplet) :
    p.validate t = false → p.process_triplet t = p := by
  unfold process_triplet
  intro h
  rw [h, Bool.false_eq_true]
  split
  · contradiction
  · rfl
  done

theorem CREVPipeline.process_triplet_valid (p : CREVPipeline) (t : RelationalTriplet) :
    p.validate t = true → p.process_triplet t = p.integrate t := by
  unfold process_triplet
  intro h
  rw [h]
  split
  · rfl
  · contradiction
  done

def KnowledgeGraphIndex.query_subject (self : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (s : String) : List RelationalTriplet :=
  (self.subject_map.find? s).getD []

theorem KnowledgeGraphIndex.query_subject_empty (s : String) :
    KnowledgeGraphIndex.empty.query_subject s = [] := by
  unfold query_subject
  unfold empty
  rw [Lean.RBMap.find?_empty]

    rw [Nat.beq_eq_false_iff_ne]

  rw [h_cap]

    · apply div_nonneg
      · exact Nat.cast_nonneg sb.size

    · apply div_le_one
      · exact Nat.cast_nonneg sb.capacity
      · apply Nat.cast_le.mpr

        have h_size : sb.size ≤ sb.capacity := by
          match h_s : sb.size ≤ sb.capacity with
          | true => exact Nat.le_of_ble_eq_true h_s
          | false =>
            have h_gt : sb.size > sb.capacity := Nat.gt_of_not_le (Nat.not_le_of_ble_eq_false h_s)

  done

def CREVPipeline.is_consistent (t1 t2 : RelationalTriplet) : Bool :=
  if t1.subject == t2.subject && t1.object == t2.object then
    if t1.relation == "is_a" && t2.relation == "is_not" then false
    else if t1.relation == "is_not" && t2.relation == "is_a" then false
    else true
  else true

theorem CREVPipeline.consistency_refl (t : RelationalTriplet) (h : t.relation ≠ "is_a" ∨ t.relation ≠ "is_not") :
    CREVPipeline.is_consistent t t = true := by
  unfold is_consistent
  rw [BEq.refl, BEq.refl, Bool.and_self]
  split
  · split
    · split
      · have h1 : t.relation = "is_a" := by
          match h_r : t.relation == "is_a" with
          | true => exact String.eq_of_beq_true h_r
          | false => contradiction
        have h2 : t.relation = "is_not" := by
          match h_r : t.relation == "is_not" with
          | true => exact String.eq_of_beq_true h_r
          | false => contradiction
        rw [h1] at h2
        contradiction
      · rfl
    · rfl
  · rfl
  done

theorem CREVPipeline.consistency_symm (t1 t2 : RelationalTriplet) :
    CREVPipeline.is_consistent t1 t2 = CREVPipeline.is_consistent t2 t1 := by
  unfold is_consistent
  have h_so : (t1.subject == t2.subject && t1.object == t2.object) = (t2.subject == t1.subject && t2.object == t1.object) := by
    rw [String.beq_comm t1.subject t2.subject, String.beq_comm t1.object t2.object]
  rw [h_so]
  split
  · split
    · split
      · contradiction
      · split
        · rfl
        · rfl
    · split
      · split
        · rfl
        · rfl
      · split
        · rfl
        · rfl
  · rfl
  done

  · have h : ¬(t1.confidence ≥ t2.confidence) := by

def KnowledgeGraphIndex.remove (self : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (t : RelationalTriplet) : KnowledgeGraphIndex :=
  let s_list := (self.subject_map.find? t.subject).getD []
  let r_list := (self.relation_map.find? t.relation).getD []
  let o_list := (self.object_map.find? t.object).getD []
  let new_s := s_list.filter (λ x => ¬x.equals t)
  let new_r := r_list.filter (λ x => ¬x.equals t)
  let new_o := o_list.filter (λ x => ¬x.equals t)
  { subject_map := if new_s.isEmpty then self.subject_map.erase t.subject else self.subject_map.insert t.subject new_s,
    relation_map := if new_r.isEmpty then self.relation_map.erase t.relation else self.relation_map.insert t.relation new_r,
    object_map := if new_o.isEmpty then self.object_map.erase t.object else self.object_map.insert t.object new_o,
    all_triplets := self.all_triplets.filter (λ x => ¬x.equals t) }

    (idx.remove t).all_triplets.length < idx.all_triplets.length := by
  unfold remove
  apply List.length_filter_lt
  · intro x hx
    exact Decidable.decide (¬RelationalTriplet.equals x t)
  · use t
    constructor
    · exact h
    · rw [RelationalTriplet.equals_refl]
      rfl
  done

theorem KnowledgeGraphIndex.remove_not_present (idx : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (t : RelationalTriplet) (h : ∀ x ∈ idx.all_triplets, ¬x.equals t) :
    (idx.remove t).all_triplets = idx.all_triplets := by
  unfold remove
  apply List.filter_true
  intro x hx
  rw [h x hx]
  rfl
  done

import Mathlib

def clamp01 (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if x < 0 then 0 else if x > 1 then 1 else x

theorem clamp01_lower_bound (x : ℝ) : clamp01 x ≥ 0 := by
  unfold clamp01
  split
  · linarith
  · split
    · linarith
    · linarith
  done

theorem clamp01_upper_bound (x : ℝ) : clamp01 x ≤ 1 := by
  unfold clamp01
  split
  · linarith
  · split
    · linarith
    · linarith
  done

theorem clamp01_idempotent (x : ℝ) : clamp01 (clamp01 x) = clamp01 x := by
  unfold clamp01
  split
  · split
    · rfl
    · split
      · linarith
      · linarith
  · split
    · split
      · linarith
      · split
        · rfl
        · linarith
    · split
      · linarith
      · split
        · linarith
        · rfl
  done

inductive ExtractionStage : Type
  | tokenization
  | triplet_extraction
  | validation
  | integration
  | indexing
  deriving BEq, DecidableEq

def ExtractionStage.toString (self : ExtractionStage) : String :=
  match self with
  | .tokenization => "tokenization"
  | .triplet_extraction => "triplet_extraction"
  | .validation => "validation"
  | .integration => "integration"
  | .indexing => "indexing"

def ExtractionStage.next (self : ExtractionStage) : Option ExtractionStage :=
  match self with
  | .tokenization => some .triplet_extraction
  | .triplet_extraction => some .validation
  | .validation => some .integration
  | .integration => some .indexing
  | .indexing => none

theorem ExtractionStage.next_tokenization : ExtractionStage.next .tokenization = some .triplet_extraction := by
  unfold next
  rfl
  done

  unfold next
  rfl
  done

theorem ExtractionStage.toString_injective (s1 s2 : ExtractionStage) : s1.toString = s2.toString → s1 = s2 := by
  intro h
  cases s1 <;> cases s2 <;> (unfold toString at h; injection h; rfl)
  done

structure RelationalTriplet where
  subject : String
  relation : String
  object : String
  confidence : ℝ
  extraction_time : Int
  source_hash : Vector UInt8 32
  metadata : Lean.RBMap String String Ord.compare

def RelationalTriplet.init (s r o : String) (conf : ℝ) (time : Int) (hash : Vector UInt8 32) : RelationalTriplet :=
  { subject := s,
    relation := r,
    object := o,
    confidence := clamp01 conf,
    extraction_time := time,
    source_hash := hash,
    metadata := Lean.RBMap.empty }

theorem RelationalTriplet.init_confidence_valid (s r o : String) (conf : ℝ) (time : Int) (hash : Vector UInt8 32) :
    0 ≤ (RelationalTriplet.init s r o conf time hash).confidence ∧ (RelationalTriplet.init s r o conf time hash).confidence ≤ 1 := by
  unfold init
  constructor
  · apply clamp01_lower_bound
  · apply clamp01_upper_bound
  done

def RelationalTriplet.equals (self other : RelationalTriplet) : Bool :=
  self.subject == other.subject && self.relation == other.relation && self.object == other.object

theorem RelationalTriplet.equals_refl (t : RelationalTriplet) : t.equals t = true := by
  unfold equals
  rw [BEq.refl, BEq.refl, BEq.refl]
  rfl
  done

theorem RelationalTriplet.equals_symm (t1 t2 : RelationalTriplet) : t1.equals t2 = t2.equals t1 := by
  unfold equals
  cases h1 : t1.subject == t2.subject
  · rw [Bool.and_false, Bool.and_false]
    have h1' : (t2.subject == t1.subject) = false := by
      rw [← h1]
      apply String.beq_comm
    rw [h1']
    rfl
  · cases h2 : t1.relation == t2.relation
    · rw [Bool.and_false, Bool.and_false]
      have h2' : (t2.relation == t1.relation) = false := by
        rw [← h2]
        apply String.beq_comm
      rw [h2']
      rfl
    · cases h3 : t1.object == t2.object
      · rw [Bool.and_false, Bool.and_false]
        have h3' : (t2.object == t1.object) = false := by
          rw [← h3]
          apply String.beq_comm
        rw [h3']
        rfl
      · rw [Bool.and_true, Bool.and_true]
        have h1' : (t2.subject == t1.subject) = true := by
          rw [← h1]
          apply String.beq_comm
        have h2' : (t2.relation == t1.relation) = true := by
          rw [← h2]
          apply String.beq_comm
        have h3' : (t2.object == t1.object) = true := by
          rw [← h3]
          apply String.beq_comm
        rw [h1', h2', h3']
        rfl
  done

structure KnowledgeGraphIndex where
  subject_map : Lean.RBMap String (List RelationalTriplet) Ord.compare
  relation_map : Lean.RBMap String (List RelationalTriplet) Ord.compare

def KnowledgeGraphIndex.empty : KnowledgeGraphIndex :=
  { subject_map := Lean.RBMap.empty,
    relation_map := Lean.RBMap.empty,
    object_map := Lean.RBMap.empty,
    all_triplets := [] }

def KnowledgeGraphIndex.index (self : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (t : RelationalTriplet) : KnowledgeGraphIndex :=
  let s_list := (self.subject_map.find? t.subject).getD []
  let r_list := (self.relation_map.find? t.relation).getD []
  let o_list := (self.object_map.find? t.object).getD []
  { subject_map := self.subject_map.insert t.subject (t :: s_list),
    relation_map := self.relation_map.insert t.relation (t :: r_list),
    object_map := self.object_map.insert t.object (t :: o_list),
    all_triplets := t :: self.all_triplets }

theorem KnowledgeGraphIndex.index_increases_size (idx : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (t : RelationalTriplet) :
    (idx.index t).all_triplets.length = idx.all_triplets.length + 1 := by
  unfold index
  rw [List.length_cons]
  rfl
  done

    (idx.index t).subject_map.find? t.subject = some (t :: (idx.subject_map.find? t.subject).getD []) := by
  unfold index
  rw [Lean.RBMap.find?_insert]
  rfl

structure StreamBuffer where
  data : List (Option RelationalTriplet)
  capacity : Nat
  head : Nat
  tail : Nat
  size : Nat

def StreamBuffer.init (cap : Nat) : StreamBuffer :=
  { data := List.replicate cap none,
    capacity := cap,
    head := 0,
    tail := 0,
    size := 0 }

theorem StreamBuffer.init_empty (cap : Nat) : (StreamBuffer.init cap).size = 0 := by
  unfold init
  rfl
  done

def StreamBuffer.isFull (self : StreamBuffer) : Bool :=
  self.size >= self.capacity

def StreamBuffer.isEmpty (self : StreamBuffer) : Bool :=
  self.size == 0

def StreamBuffer.push (self : StreamBuffer) (t : RelationalTriplet) : Option StreamBuffer :=
  if self.isFull then none
  else
    let new_data := self.data.set self.tail (some t)
    some { self with
           data := new_data,
           tail := (self.tail + 1) % self.capacity,
           size := self.size + 1 }

theorem StreamBuffer.push_size_inc (sb : StreamBuffer) (t : RelationalTriplet) (h : sb.isFull = false) :
    ∃ sb', sb.push t = some sb' ∧ sb'.size = sb.size + 1 := by
  unfold push
  rw [h]
  split
  · contradiction
  · use { sb with data := sb.data.set sb.tail (some t), tail := (sb.tail + 1) % sb.capacity, size := sb.size + 1 }
    constructor
    · rfl
    · rfl
  done

def StreamBuffer.pop (self : StreamBuffer) : Option (RelationalTriplet × StreamBuffer) :=
  if self.isEmpty then none
  else
    match self.data.get? self.head with
    | some (some t) =>
        let new_data := self.data.set self.head none
        some (t, { self with
                   data := new_data,
                   head := (self.head + 1) % self.capacity,
                   size := self.size - 1 })
    | _ => none

theorem StreamBuffer.pop_size_dec (sb : StreamBuffer) (t : RelationalTriplet) (sb' : StreamBuffer) :
    sb.pop = some (t, sb') → sb'.size = sb.size - 1 := by
  unfold pop
  intro h
  split at h
  · contradiction
  · match h_data : sb.data.get? sb.head with
    | some (some t_val) =>
      rw [h_data] at h
      injection h with h_t h_sb
      rw [← h_sb]
      rfl
    | _ => rw [h_data] at h; contradiction
  done

structure RelationStatistics where
  count : Nat
  total_confidence : ℝ
  avg_confidence : ℝ
  m2 : ℝ

def RelationStatistics.init : RelationStatistics :=
  { count := 0,
    total_confidence := 0,
    avg_confidence := 0,
    m2 := 0 }

def RelationStatistics.update (self : RelationStatistics) (conf : ℝ) : RelationStatistics :=
  let x := clamp01 conf
  let new_count := self.count + 1
  let delta := x - self.avg_confidence
  let new_avg := self.avg_confidence + delta / (new_count : ℝ)
  let delta2 := x - new_avg
  let new_m2 := self.m2 + delta * delta2
  { count := new_count,
    total_confidence := self.total_confidence + x,
    avg_confidence := new_avg,
    m2 := new_m2 }

theorem RelationStatistics.update_count (stats : RelationStatistics) (c : ℝ) :
    (stats.update c).count = stats.count + 1 := by
  unfold update
  rfl
  done

theorem RelationStatistics.update_confidence_sum (stats : RelationStatistics) (c : ℝ) :

  unfold update
  rfl
  done

  unfold allocate
  rfl
  done

def CREVPipeline.integrate (self : CREVPipeline) (t : RelationalTriplet) : CREVPipeline :=
  let new_index := self.index.index t
  let stats := (self.rel_stats.find? t.relation).getD RelationStatistics.init
  let new_stats := stats.update t.confidence
  let new_rel_stats := self.rel_stats.insert t.relation new_stats
  let data_str := t.subject ++ "|" ++ t.relation ++ "|" ++ t.object
  let new_kernel := self.kernel.allocate data_str
  let new_buffer_opt := self.buffer.push t

    | some b => b
    | none => match self.buffer.pop with
      | some (_, b_popped) => (b_popped.push t).getD b_popped

def CREVPipeline.is_consistent (t1 t2 : RelationalTriplet) : Bool :=
  if t1.subject == t2.subject && t1.object == t2.object then
    if t1.relation == "is_a" && t2.relation == "is_not" then false
    else if t1.relation == "is_not" && t2.relation == "is_a" then false
    else true
  else true

theorem CREVPipeline.consistency_refl (t : RelationalTriplet) (h : t.relation ≠ "is_a" ∨ t.relation ≠ "is_not") :
    CREVPipeline.is_consistent t t = true := by
  unfold is_consistent
  rw [BEq.refl, BEq.refl, Bool.and_self]
  split
  · split
    · split
      · have h1 : t.relation = "is_a" := by
          match h_r : t.relation == "is_a" with
          | true => exact String.eq_of_beq_true h_r
          | false => contradiction
        have h2 : t.relation = "is_not" := by
          match h_r : t.relation == "is_not" with
          | true => exact String.eq_of_beq_true h_r
          | false => contradiction
        rw [h1] at h2
        contradiction
      · rfl
    · rfl
  · rfl
  done

theorem CREVPipeline.consistency_symm (t1 t2 : RelationalTriplet) :
    CREVPipeline.is_consistent t1 t2 = CREVPipeline.is_consistent t2 t1 := by
  unfold is_consistent
  have h_so : (t1.subject == t2.subject && t1.object == t2.object) = (t2.subject == t1.subject && t2.object == t1.object) := by
    rw [String.beq_comm t1.subject t2.subject, String.beq_comm t1.object t2.object]
  rw [h_so]
  split
  · split
    · split
      · contradiction
      · split
        · rfl
        · rfl
    · split
      · split
        · rfl
        · rfl
      · split
        · rfl
        · rfl
  · rfl
  done

theorem CREVPipeline.resolve_conflict_confidence (t1 t2 : RelationalTriplet) :
    (CREVPipeline.resolve_conflict t1 t2).confidence = max t1.confidence t2.confidence := by
  unfold resolve_conflict
  unfold max
  split
  · have h : t1.confidence ≥ t2.confidence := by
      match h_c : t1.confidence ≥ t2.confidence with
      | true => exact h_c
      | false => contradiction
    rw [if_pos h]
  · have h : ¬(t1.confidence ≥ t2.confidence) := by
      match h_c : t1.confidence ≥ t2.confidence with
      | true => contradiction
      | false => exact h_c
    rw [if_neg h]
  done

def KnowledgeGraphIndex.remove (self : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (t : RelationalTriplet) : KnowledgeGraphIndex :=
  let s_list := (self.subject_map.find? t.subject).getD []
  let r_list := (self.relation_map.find? t.relation).getD []
  let o_list := (self.object_map.find? t.object).getD []
  let new_s := s_list.filter (λ x => ¬x.equals t)
  let new_r := r_list.filter (λ x => ¬x.equals t)
  let new_o := o_list.filter (λ x => ¬x.equals t)
  { subject_map := if new_s.isEmpty then self.subject_map.erase t.subject else self.subject_map.insert t.subject new_s,
    relation_map := if new_r.isEmpty then self.relation_map.erase t.relation else self.relation_map.insert t.relation new_r,
    object_map := if new_o.isEmpty then self.object_map.erase t.object else self.object_map.insert t.object new_o,
    all_triplets := self.all_triplets.filter (λ x => ¬x.equals t) }

    (idx.remove t).all_triplets.length < idx.all_triplets.length := by
  unfold remove
  apply List.length_filter_lt
  · intro x hx
    exact Decidable.decide (¬RelationalTriplet.equals x t)
  · use t
    constructor
    · exact h
    · rw [RelationalTriplet.equals_refl]
      rfl
  done

theorem KnowledgeGraphIndex.remove_not_present (idx : KnowledgeGraphIndex) (t : RelationalTriplet) (h : ∀ x ∈ idx.all_triplets, ¬x.equals t) :
    (idx.remove t).all_triplets = idx.all_triplets := by
  unfold remove
  apply List.filter_true
  intro x hx
  rw [h x hx]
  rfl
  done
